entries.zh: 在诉讼中上诉；诉告（提起诉讼）
entries.en: to appeal in a lawsuit; to lodge a plaint

entries.zh: 诉冤，申诉冤屈；控诉遭人欺压、横加负担之不公
entries.en: to appeal against injustice; to plead grievance at being imposed upon
entries.notes: H 第二字标[疑:冤/覓]，M ôy 与 R vâng 均指向「枉」，「冤枉」可定。

entries.zh: 上诉并向法庭辩白、陈明（诉明）
entries.en: to appeal and clear oneself before the court
to appeal by petition; to file a written plaint

entries.zh: 以诉词陈情上诉（呈递诉词）
entries.en: to appeal by petition; to put forward the plaint's statement
entries.notes: L 尾语「con diminos monta」费解，释义依 H「訴詞」与前三栏定。

entries.zh: 分诉，逐项辩白；详细陈诉案情
entries.en: to plead in detail; to state one's case item by item
entries.notes: L 尾「aîropech」未详，释义依 H「分訴」（分辩诉说）定。

entries.en: to appeal to one's superior
to appeal to the superior by petition

entries.zh: 向上级递诉状，具状上诉
entries.en: to appeal to the superior with a written plaint
to be on one's guard; to prepare, make ready

entries.zh: 防备，戒备；处于预备状态
entries.en: to be on guard; to stand prepared
to defend oneself; to stand alert
to keep watch; to defend, guard
to defend oneself; to protect one's person

entries.zh: 整备防守，做好戒备（以待敌）
entries.en: to put oneself in readiness; to prepare for defense
entries.notes: H 首字标[疑:開/關]，音读 cuān 与二字皆不合；L 作 aprestarse，取「整备」义。

entries.en: to hold firm; to stand guard against the enemy
to press down
entries.notes: L「Apegar」当为「apear／apexar」之讹写，H 作「按」、M/R 皆 ân/ngān，义可定。

entries.zh: 按落去：向下按压、放下（并列义：抛掷、装载、悬挂）
entries.en: to press down, to lower (with the listed senses: to fling, to load, to hang)
entries.notes: L 并列 guitar（抛）、cargar（载）、colgar（挂）三义，H 只作「按落去」，释义以 H 为主。

entries.zh: 按压并拖带（所载之物）；压住载物而行
entries.en: to press down and haul (a load); to bear down on what is carried
entries.notes: H「按帶」非常用组合，L「este cargado」所指不明，义据「按＋帶」与「载」推。

entries.en: appellation, name; surname
entries.notes: L「Apellid.」为 apellido（姓氏）之缩写，H 只作「號」，故并列「名号」为首义。

entries.en: barely, almost; close at hand
entries.notes: R 栏带「(mantuch.)」注记，R 读 liên liân 与 H「臨臨」不严格对应，取「将近、临近」义。

entries.en: appetite, desire, lust; to long for

entries.zh: 欲心萌动，心生向往；对某物的偏好
entries.en: appetite and inclination toward something; desire stirring in the heart
